text: as sprout and leaf and fruit stand in the banyan seed in bodies exactly fitted to them so this whole world in all its varied makings stands inside the seed of the heart as in peacock egg juice the craftsman s skill already holds every feather s line and plume variety for those rich in attention to weigh with subtle sight as the great tree stands in the banyan seed in power form so this world moving and unmoving stands in the heart seed by this traditional maxim in the heart seed shaped as the supreme lady this world is contained how so as the ultimate truth of pot and bowl clay s transformations is clay itself as watery kinds examined settle into water in common so the levels from earth to illusion examined for what is real in them prove to be being itself even of the word being itself strip the suffix that shows the root s sense and the bare stem letter s alone is left and inside it stand thirty one levels beyond it pure knowledge the lord and eternal siva knowledge and action in essence enter as special powers into the syllable au shaped as assent formed of unsurpassed power hence the supreme emission shaped as creation above and below the breath out to be breathed of the heart seed so formed shaped as the great mantra shaped as the world beyond the world supreme siva himself as the seat where all rising comes to rest is its own nature all shapedness then shapelessness each in turn the cause whoever truly knows such a heart seed and enters it he is initiated in the highest sense this very knowing with no sesame and ghee oblation is initiation in truth still breathing living as men live he is free while living and when the body falls he becomes the lord supreme siva himself
